notes.title: Achievements! Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
Hey Light Chasers,

We received some reports about the kill count achievement not working.
We have looked into it and fixed the issue, now all achievements are unlockable.

[list]
[*] Fixed killing achievement not tracking over multiple playthroughs
[/list]

Thank you for the continued support.
Keep on shining.

-Outshine team

notes.title: THANK YOU! Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
Hey Light Chasers,

Thank you for your support!
We have listened to your feedback and addressed some issues in this hotfix:

[list]
[*] Fixed "Й" in Russian language not being recognized
[*] Improved (un)loading times.
[/list]

Thank you again for the positive reactions and the good reviews, it helps a lot!
Keep on shining.

-Outshine team

notes.title: THANK YOU! Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Hey Light Chasers,

First and foremost, thank you for your support! We really enjoyed watching your videos and streams.
We have noticed a few issues that are addressed in this hotfix:

[list]
[*] Fixed enemy spawning in world 2 level1 section1
[*] Fixed boss ending background
[*] Fixed shield visuals
[*] Fixed laser collider
[*] Fixed issue with shield not blocking damage
[*] Updated UI to better reflect the selected modifiers
[/list]
